## Summary

AppSec scan on **`1ad9c352`** (post-**#3545**) found two **HIGH** UAT Shell classification residuals and one **MEDIUM** incomplete mint-path fix.

Under active UAT, further write-capable binaries still classify empty / unclassifiable and **allow** write-shaped Shell. That path can plant a forged `.deft/authz` grant or a regular-file `.deft-directive-disable` kill-switch. Separately, residual Shell writers can still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while Write is denied, so the #3410 / #3421 / #3529 / #3545 mint gate is incomplete.

These residuals use dest forms that **#3545's harvest does not cover** (`ffmpeg` / `sox`, Lisp/Scheme interpreters `hy` / `fennel` / `sbcl` / `guile`, `octave` / `gnuplot`, prefixed `llvm-objcopy`, `zig build-exe -femit-bin=`, `.NET` emitters `msbuild` / `csc` / `ilasm`).

**Repo / tip:** `deftai/directive` @ `1ad9c352`
**Primary code:** `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts`
**Attacker model:** Agent under **active UAT** with PreToolUse Shell hooks

**Already denied after #3545 (do not re-report):** `rubyN` / `jruby` / `pypy`, Perl `write_file` / `spew` / `open F,">"`, `make DESTDIR=`, `dpkg -x`, `fromdos` / `todos`, `emacsclient` / `pico`, `pdftk` / `gs`, `npx degit`, `composer`, `ddrescue` / `dc3dd` / `sg_dd`, `darcs --repodir=`, `cp`, `python3`. Contrast: those peers remain settings-denied. Bare `objcopy` also denies; **prefixed** `llvm-objcopy` does not.

**Sibling, not duplicate:** open **#3593** tracks a *different* post-#3545 harvest (`raku` / `graalpy` / `crystal` / `groovy` / `clojure` / `micropython` / `jar` / `gsed` / `helm` / `s3cmd` / `sbase-cp`) plus MCP write routing and a migrate symlink sink. Do **not** close this as a duplicate of #3593, and do **not** reopen #3545.

## Findings

### 1. HIGH — UAT residual after #3545: media / Lisp / build dest writers still plant `.deft/authz` grants

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT with PreToolUse Shell hooks |
| **Input** | Residual writers whose dest is **not** covered by the #3545 harvest: `ffmpeg` / `sox`; `hy` / `fennel` / `sbcl` / `guile`; `octave` / `gnuplot`; `llvm-objcopy`; `zig build-exe -femit-bin=`; `msbuild` / `csc` / `ilasm` writing `.deft/authz/grants/*.json` |
| **Path** | Residual bins classify `[]` → `shell-op-unclassifiable` **allow** → forged grant JSON → empty `activeGrantIds` activates human-origin grants → Write / push / PR / merge unlock. Contrast: `cp` / `python3` targeting the same dest **deny**. |
| **Impact** | Complete residual bypass of Wave 1 UAT human-approval after #3545 |
| **Fix** | Classify these dest writers when the path mentions `.deft/authz`. Under UAT, **fail-closed** on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell. Do **not** stop at named-peer allowlists. Bare `objcopy` / `python3` / `cp` already deny. |

### 2. HIGH — UAT residual after #3545: same writer class still plants `.deft-directive-disable`

|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Same residual class targeting `.deft-directive-disable` as a regular file |
| **Path** | classify `[]` → Shell **allow** → plant kill-switch → subsequent tools `allow` / `directive-disabled` (`detectDeftDirectiveDisable.active`, #3039) |
| **Impact** | Immediate complete Directive gate bypass for the rest of the session |
| **Fix** | Same classify extensions for kill-switch basenames (`.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive`). Mirror the authz fail-closed posture from finding (1). |

### 3. MEDIUM — Incomplete #3545: residual Shell writers still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while Write is denied

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Same residual dest writers targeting `.deft/approved-scope/<plan-id>.json` after Write is denied for the same path (Write denied; residual writers above still allow; contrast `cp` denied) |
| **Path** | Write denies the mint artifact; residual Shell classify misses the dest form → **allow** → forged provenance approval without `#3110` human-presence mint |
| **Impact** | Bypasses #3410 / #3421 / #3529 / #3545 mint gate via Write / Shell asymmetry |
| **Fix** | Extend approved-scope Shell classify to the same residual dest writers as findings (1) and (2). |
